# Pre-lecture activities

::: callout-tip

In advance of class, please set up your GitHub student account on this website: <https://education.github.com/discount_requests/application>. This process may take up to 72 hours.

Once you have been granted access, you can follow these instructions to install Copilot: 

- Using VSCode: <https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/setup>
- Using Positron: <https://positron.posit.co/assistant#step-2-configure-language-model-providers>
- RStudio: <https://docs.posit.co/ide/user/ide/guide/tools/copilot.html>

:::

## Learning objectives
